author: sooner state news
title: Seminole State College softball team to compete in NJCAA World Series on May 25
text:
The Seminole State College softball team will compete in the National Junior College Athletic Association Division I Softball JUCO World Series beginning May 25 at Choccolocco Park in Oxford, Alabama.
The tournament marks an important event for the college’s athletic program, offering players the opportunity to showcase their skills on a national stage. The opening game for Seminole State College is scheduled for Monday, May 25 at 3:30 p.m., where they will face Volunteer State Community College.
Tournament updates, a live stream link, and the official bracket are available for those interested in following the team’s progress. Fans and supporters can access these resources to stay informed throughout the competition.
Choccolocco Park in Oxford serves as the venue for this year’s championship series. The NJCAA Division I Softball JUCO World Series brings together top junior college teams from across the country to compete for national honors.
The outcome of this tournament may have implications not only for Seminole State College but also highlights achievements within junior college athletics more broadly. Observers can look forward to seeing how participating teams perform as play unfolds.
